scope: Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken through Symphonic Destruction

evidence_summary.transformations: Maintained Xenoverse 2 transformation research and exact-name skill pages covering character-only Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken and Supersonic Mode, Saiyan CaC Super Saiyan God/SSGSS/SSGSS Evolved, and Super Vegeta training.
evidence_summary.super_spirit_bomb: Exact-name skill documentation plus independent Dragon Ball and community evidence identify Expert Mission 16 as the acquisition route.
evidence_summary.supernova: Exact-name skill documentation identifies Expert Mission 6 (The Depths of Despair) and the 500 Ki Ultimate; existing maintained Steam corroboration remains preserved in the canonical source set.
evidence_summary.supernova_cooler: Mentor documentation plus independent Dragon Ball evidence identify Cooler (Final Form) Lesson 3 as the acquisition endpoint.
evidence_summary.supreme_fury: Maintained PQ/skill evidence identifies PQ179 and the explicit Ultimate Finish route; existing conflicting reward-list presentation remains preserved.
evidence_summary.surging_spirit: Exact-name skill documentation preserves the built-in Ultra Instinct action/non-standalone acquisition semantics.
evidence_summary.symphonic_destruction: Maintained mentor evidence identifies Whis mentor training as the acquisition endpoint; detailed combat mechanics remain bounded.

limits: Preserved character-only versus CaC-only scope distinctions.
Preserved existing reward-tier conflicts rather than collapsing conflicting presentations.
No unsupported drop probability, prerequisite chain, timer, stacking cap, frame data, or damage value was added.
